parsed.label: numbers and units
parsed.trigger_hypothesis: The neuron activates positively on tokens that are numbers or units of measurement (especially years, quantities) and negatively on tokens that are artistic or technical genres (musical, API).
parsed.output_hypothesis: The neuron may promote factual, quantitative content and suppress artistic or technical genre labels.
alternatives: The neuron responds to tokens that are part of compound nouns or technical terms, with sign determined by domain.
The neuron detects whether the token is a common noun versus a proper noun or specialized term.
parsed.adapter_changes: State changes are minimal; slight activation increases in emotional contexts (W21) and code contexts (W22) suggest the neuron may be slightly modulated by sentiment or technicality.

proposed_tests.discriminates: unit of measurement vs ordinary noun

proposed_tests.b_text: It happened number 5000 in the list.

proposed_tests.a_text: She starred in the musical comedy.
proposed_tests.b_text: She starred in the funny comedy.

proposed_tests.a_text: We built a REST API service.

proposed_tests.discriminates: technical module name vs common word
salt as unit vs salt as flavor
chameleon as animal vs other words
jump as sports term vs action
proposed_tests.a_text: A quad is a figure skating jump.

proposed_tests.discriminates: loop as technical term vs common word
proposed_tests.a_text: The quadruple toe loop is difficult.
proposed_tests.b_text: He made a loop with the rope.
